_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Worm Holes#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#001.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#001.dst: 好啦伙计们，这个赶紧收尾！这种洞多的是！
The Worm Holes#001.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#003.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#003.dst: 脚手架裂了！所有人，马上下来！！
The Worm Holes#003.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#005.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#005.dst: 噢，该死……我就知道这项工程打从一开始就是个失败……Willam 和 Clint 就这样没了！
The Worm Holes#005.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#006.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#006.dst: 我得找个够强悍的人下去……嗯？嘿，一个人类！过来这边！
The Worm Holes#006.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#007.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#007.dst: 我得问问，刚才的事你看到多少，Wynn 来的伙计？场面不好看，而我是那些人的头儿，我得负起责任。
The Worm Holes#007.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#008.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#008.dst: {p} 的镇长看到这些洞冒出来，就雇我们来把它们填上。问题是，地面太不稳，根本没法施工。
The Worm Holes#008.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#009.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#009.dst: 这一带越来越让人担心了。这些洞最近才开始冒出来，还有地震。感觉整个地方都要塌了！
The Worm Holes#009.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#010.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#010.dst: 我觉得我们该下去弄清楚到底是怎么回事，而你是我们当中装备最好的，毕竟是人类嘛。
The Worm Holes#010.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#011.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#011.dst: 你能不能下去看看，找点线索？洞的左边就有条路可以下去。
The Worm Holes#011.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#012.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#012.dst: 下到洞里找出这件事的起因，带着证据回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Malo 那里。

The Worm Holes#013.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#013.dst: 这到底是什么鬼……？你在下面找到了什么，士兵？
The Worm Holes#013.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#014.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#014.dst: 噢，只是一张皮，是吗？可恶……还希望你看到了是什么东西，因为这事我一点头绪都没有。
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#015.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#015.dst: 呃。我认识的人里，唯一可能知道这事的，就是那个讨厌的精灵女人……
The Worm Holes#015.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#016.dst: 她一头紫发，到处晃来晃去，好像什么都懂。是啦，她是很聪明，但也不必对我们所有人那么高高在上吧。
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#017.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#017.dst: 她在这里东边扎了营。她对你的态度大概会比对我好，所以我去找官方，看看他们有没有线索。
The Worm Holes#017.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Worm Holes#018.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到 Lari，问问是怎么回事

The Worm Holes#019.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#019.dst: ……我们见过吗？我在 Gavel 不止一次看到过你。
The Worm Holes#019.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#020.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#020.dst: 我是 Lari。要不是之前太忙，我也许早就好好跟你打过招呼了，说到这个。你来这里是有原因的，对吧？
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#021.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#021.dst: 嗯……听你的描述，我想我知道你发现了什么。我想，那张死皮也足以证明了。
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#022.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#022.dst: 蜕下那张皮的生物叫作 Grootslang。它们虽然体型庞大，却相当温和。我记得有句话叫“温柔的巨人”，是吧？
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#023.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#023.dst: 这可怕的衰败……影响了它们在地底的栖息地。它们正往离地面更近的地方寻找藏身处。我一直在试着清除衰败，却没有成功……
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#024.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#024.dst: 等等……今天又冒出了更多洞？有……有人死了？！在、在哪里，什么时候？！
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#025.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#025.dst: 不，不……！我不愿再为任何人的死负责……人类，请告诉我你的名字。
The Worm Holes#025.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#026.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#028.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#028.dst: 原来这就是现场……[Gavel 咒语]……
The Worm Holes#028.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#029.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#029.dst: 来。至少让我护送一个人安全进入深坑。
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#030.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: 相信我——跳下去。我会让你慢慢降落。
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#031.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#031.dst: 你带路。如果能在这附近找到更多 Grootslang 的痕迹，会有助于我了解情况。
The Worm Holes#031.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#032.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#032.dst: 嗯？这面墙看起来最近被动过……
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#033.dst: 我听得到……但它在往哪里爬……？
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#034.dst: 那是巨虫之母！这些洞一定是她弄出来的。我们得跟上她！
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#035.dst: 别管那些蜘蛛了，我们得继续跟着巨虫！
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#036.dst: 啊……呃，{u}？我……嗯，这个……有点难开口，不过……
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#037.dst: 我……不认为我们在这里需要战斗，或是杀戮？这些生物原本就住在这里，是我们闯进了它们的地盘。
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: 它们只是在自己的领地里生活，凭什么要被攻击？就算它们是动物，我相信不用杀戮也能解决这些问题。
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: 我……明白你也许没有我这样的力量……而我，呃……也不是毫无罪过。但我认为你可以试着采取和平的立场。
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#040.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thusfar.
The Worm Holes#040.dst: 就算在这点上只有我这么想……尽管我明白你的家乡教你的是另一套。我并不羡慕你，不过我还是感谢你一路以来的帮助。
The Worm Holes#040.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#041.dst: 你的做法……我不认同，但我觉得你依然有是非之心……好了，隧道在这里分岔了。我们得分头行动。
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: 我走右边，所以你应该继续往左走。希望我们很快就能再会合。
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#045.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#046.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#046.dst: 这只 Grootslang 反常地凶暴……离地面这么近，她很害怕。请待在我身后。
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#048.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#048.dst: 别靠近它！巨虫的力量远远不是你能承受的！
The Worm Holes#048.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.dst: 又、又来？[Gavel 咒语]——啊，快闪开！
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#050.dst: {u}！！你没受伤吧？她又害怕又痛苦！
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#051.dst: 这次我一定要做对……我要去安抚她，你待在那里别动！
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#052.dst: 请你冷静下来，我求求你。回到大地深处——你伤害到上面的人了！
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#053.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#053.dst: 大地正在腐烂……我愿负起全部责任，但上面的草地不也在腐烂吗？
The Worm Holes#053.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#054.dst: 我想抚平你的痛苦，但你得让我帮你——你必须听我说！
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#055.dst: 这样的暴力能解决什么？请冷静下来！
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#056.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#056.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#057.dst: 与 Lari 一起对抗 Grootslang

The Worm Holes#059.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#059.dst: 你听得到吗？！我会让她……让她……做点什么！把你吐出来，我也不知道！只要……求求你，别、别死！
The Worm Holes#059.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#060.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#060.dst: 我、我们……我们没有对你出过手！你这样对我们是不对的！
The Worm Holes#060.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#061.dst: 你要在愤怒中伤害并吞噬一切？就算明知道后果？
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#062.dst: 这种徒劳的破坏满足不了你的饥饿！我求求你，放他们出来！
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: 你明明知——等、等等……你从哪里……啊啊啊！
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.dst: ……你、你……我……你、你还好吗？我……*抽泣* 我……
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#065.dst: 我努力过了……为、为什么没人听我的？为什么什、什么都不会为我改变？
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#066.dst: 她……她一直在吃黑暗寄生虫。它们正在折磨她的内脏，让她头痛欲、欲裂……
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#067.dst: 我……好、好暗……我没、没法呼吸……这……这不能就这样结束……
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#068.dst: 我……不、不，我不能死在这里……还有人需、需要我……也还有人需、需要你！我……我……
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#069.dst: 我需、需要……或者……或、或者……集、集中精神，Lari……你做得到的……
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#071.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#071.dst: 放我们出去！放我们离开这里！别让我们这样死掉！我求求你了！！
The Worm Holes#071.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#072.dst: ……我……噢不……它……死、死……我……我只、只是……我只是想出、出去……噢……不、不……
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#073.dst: ……我、我们……走吧。我……我没、没办法再看下去了……
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#075.dst: 我……我真的很抱歉，{u}。如果我……我不……我根本不知道自己还能做、做些什么……
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#076.dst: 那时候……感觉它已经……什么都不剩了……可是，如果我能再快一点……会不会……会不会有什么不同？
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#077.dst: ……我算什么救世主……我得做得更好，可是还能怎么……唉，我在原地打转……
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#079.dst: ……我……我不敢相信。这……难道命运就是跟我过不去吗？我到底做了什么要遭受这些？！
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#080.dst: 巨虫之母产了卵……被寄生虫侵染的卵！每一颗孵出来都会发狂！！
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#081.dst: 你看到那个母亲有多强了……这样的侵染可能引发地震，让整个 Gavel 地区崩塌……
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#082.dst: 它们……它们必须被阻止，但是……我做不到。我没、没法杀……对不起，我就是做不到！
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#083.dst: 带一队人去……发狂的话，就连幼虫也很可怕。只要……求、求你，快点解决这件事。
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#084.dst: 你值得最好的……但那超出了我能给的……所以，给你。收下这些吧。我该走了。
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari
